metadata.title: Stellar properties and chemical features of the Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars observed by GALAH DR4

notes: No individually identifiable stars meet the criteria. The paper analyzes roughly 6,000 GCNS–GALAH DR4 stars only as a population (T:p1-b11; T:p1-b13) and reports a statistical group of 228 high-velocity stars as likely local halo members (T:p2-b2; T:p2-b9), without giving individual names or source identifiers. Moreover, the text does not explicitly establish that these stars are presently unbound from the Milky Way; halo membership alone is not a Galactic-unbound candidacy statement.
